Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on SUMOylation of the APC/C complex. While the PRIDE metadata 'identifiedPTMStrings' claims no PTMs are included, the publication text explicitly describes mass spectrometric identification of SUMOylation sites (K772, K798) and phosphorylation sites (S777, S779) on APC4. The workflow involves AP-MS (Strep-tactin/Ni-NTA) followed by LFQ.

scope: The SUMOylated recombinant complex was purified by adding Strep-tactin beads (GE Healthcare) and incubating for 2 h in 50 mM Tris pH 7.5 and 150 mM NaCl.

The bound proteins were incubated with 2 µg of trypsin on the beads overnight at 37 °C. The samples were then passed through a pre‐washed 0.45 μm filter (Millipore) and acidified with 2% Trifluoroacetic acid (Sigma). For subsequent mass spectrometric analysis, the peptides were desalted by C-18 stage tips.
